text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
“Command the sons of Israel and say to them: My offering, My food for My fire offerings, an aroma pleasing to Me, you⁺ shall be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.
And you shall say to them: This [is] the fire offering that you⁺ shall offer to YHWH: Two male lambs, sons of a year, unblemished, day by day as a regular burnt offering.
The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer in the evening,
and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with pressed oil, a fourth of a hin.
[It is] a regular burnt offering, which was made at Mount Sinai for a pleasing aroma, a fire offering to YHWH.
And its drink offering [is] a fourth of a hin for one lamb. In the Holy Place as a drink offering of strong drink to be poured out to YHWH.
And the second lamb you shall offer in the evening. As the grain offering in the morning, and its drink offering, you shall offer as a fire offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH.
And on the Sabbath day two lambs, sons of a year, unblemished, and two tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with the oil, and its drink offering—
[this is] the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
And at the beginnings of your⁺ months you⁺ shall present a burnt offering to YHWH: Two bulls, sons of the herd, and one ram and seven lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,
and three tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with the oil for one bull, and two tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with the oil for the one ram,
and a tenth part [of an ephah] of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with the oil for one lamb as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a fire offering to YHWH.

And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, a third of a hin for a ram, and a fourth of a hin for a lamb. This [is] the burnt offering for every month throughout the months of the year.
And one kid of the goats as a sin offering to YHWH besides the regular burnt offering shall be offered, and its drink offering.
And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, [is] the Passover of YHWH.
And on the fifteenth day of this month [is] the feast; for seven days unleavened [bread] shall be eaten.
On the first day [is] a holy convocation; you⁺ shall not do any customary work.
And you⁺ shall present a fire offering as a burnt offering to YHWH: Two bulls, sons of the herd, one ram, and seven lambs, sons of a year, unblemished; They shall be for you⁺.
And their grain offerings [are] of fine flour mixed with the oil—you⁺ shall prepare three tenths [of an ephah] for a bull and two tenths for a ram.
A tenth part [of an ephah] you shall prepare for the one lamb, for the seven lambs,
and one goat [as] a sin offering, to make atonement upon you⁺.
Besides the burnt offering of the morning, which [is] for a regular burnt offering, you⁺ shall prepare these.
Like these, you⁺ shall prepare day by day, seven days, the food of the fire offering a pleasing aroma to YHWH; besides the regular burnt offering it shall be made, and its drink offering.
And on the seventh day you⁺ shall have a holy convocation; you⁺ shall not do any customary work.
And on the day of the firstfruits, when you⁺ bring a new grain offering to YHWH, in your⁺ Weeks, you⁺ shall have a holy convocation; you⁺ shall not do any customary work.
And you⁺ shall present a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH, two bulls, sons of the herd, one ram, [and] seven lambs, sons of a year;
and their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with the oil, three tenths [of an ephah] for the one bull, two tenths for the one ram,
a tenth part [of an ephah] for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;
one kid of the goats to make atonement upon you⁺.
Besides the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, you⁺ shall present [them] and their drink offerings. They shall be unblemished.
